founders.name: Molly Maguire
founders.bio: By day, an RICS-chartered surveyor with ten years' experience structuring and negotiating high-value commercial contracts, and assisting corporates in strategy curation across global real estate portfolios — most recently as Senior Commercial Leasing Manager at a FTSE 250 REIT, negotiating over £19m in lease value last year alone. Molly has a proven track record in the commercial sector which she uses to propel the strategy behind TJ the frenchie & more recently Tayto the frenchie.

founders.name: Duncan Tout
founders.bio: The face of TJ and Duncan, a pet content creator and recognisable brand built from the ground up to a combined 2 million followers across platforms. Duncan provides advice on creative strategy, production, and what actually gets an audience to watch, trust, and buy.

closingNote: Most content advisors have never negotiated a contract with real financial weight behind it. Most commercial negotiators have never built an audience or made content themselves. Between us, we've done both — which is what we bring to your content and partnership strategy.

services.title: Content Audit
services.description: A written audit of your current approach and a 90-day plan — what you should be posting, how to grow in your sector and build trust from your audience through content.
services.fee: DELIVERED IN 7–10 DAYS · ONE FOLLOW-UP SESSION INCLUDED

services.title: Influencer & Partnership Strategy
services.description: We assess the options with a commercial lens to help you to design the most robust and efficient approach to partnerships. Whether thats large scale influencers and ambassadors, micro and nano creators, UGC or product seeding— a bespoke approach to each company.

services.title: Content Briefs & Video Concepts
services.description: Specific, shootable ideas — assistance with content briefs ready to hand to a videographer, editor, or in-house team, so strategy turns into content without another hire.
services.fee: DELIVERED PER BATCH · TURNAROUND AGREED UPFRONT

services.title: Founder-Led Content Strategy
services.description: Your own expertise is content most brands underuse. I build a strategy around what you already know, so it costs less than paid partnerships and is harder for anyone else to copy.
services.fee: INCLUDED IN AUDIT · AVAILABLE AS STANDALONE

services.title: Contract Review
services.description: Considering a brand partnership? I'll review the agreement — usage rights, exclusivity, fees — and flag anything that puts you at a disadvantage before you sign.
